_about: Manager names, read by the site (index.html) and the Fleaflicker sync.
aliasOverrides: lower-case text found anywhere in a team label -> the manager it belongs to, e.g. "oldusername": "Smokers Haven".
exactAliases: one person's other username (lower case, matched exactly, e.g. their Fleaflicker name) -> the manager name.
managers: manager -> { "tagline": "...", "color": "#3b82f6" } for the Trophy Room cards.
